provenance: Original deterministic synthesis by tools/generate-audio.mjs. No recordings, external assets, network calls or billable services.

integration.master: Respect the sound toggle; do not autoplay before the player enables sound.
integration.ambience: Optional. Suggested playback volume 0.35; use 0.5 s fades when starting/stopping.
integration.footsteps: Alternate A/B only while the avatar moves; do not trigger every render frame.
integration.hover: Optional, disabled by default to avoid auditory clutter.
integration.signals: All feedback must also have a visible equivalent.

sounds.name: ui-hover
sounds.description: Quiet, rounded wooden touch for optional hover feedback.

sounds.name: ui-select
sounds.description: Soft two-part pluck for selection and opening a card.

sounds.name: footstep-a
sounds.description: Muted gravel/oak footstep; alternate A and B, tied to actual movement.

sounds.name: footstep-b
sounds.description: Muted gravel/oak footstep; alternate A and B, tied to actual movement.

sounds.name: build-place
sounds.description: Warm construction impact: low body, short wood knock and a restrained grain.

sounds.name: quest-complete
sounds.description: Three gentle ascending notes for a completed learning task.

sounds.name: milestone
sounds.description: Short warm major-sixth resolution; reserve for meaningful milestones.

sounds.name: ui-unavailable
sounds.description: Quiet descending cue; no buzzer or alarm.

sounds.name: courtyard-ambience
sounds.description: Subtle seamless tonal courtyard bed. Start only on opt-in; loop quietly.
